description: The first response is delayed past timeout_ms, giving curl exit 28 (retryable); the second succeeds. Curl's own text never reaches the final state outside `meta.attempts`, where the first (failed) attempt's own text is matched by pattern (third_party_text), not byte-for-byte.

third_party_text.pattern: ollama request failed \(curl exit 28\) model='test-model' url=http://127\.0\.0\.1:<MOCK_PORT>/api/generate: curl: \(28\) Operation timed out.*? The model didn't finish within 1s\. Raise `runtime\.adapters\.ollama\.timeout_seconds` in your config \(a prompt's `timeout_ms` can only shorten it\), or use a smaller/faster model\.
